conditions.displayName: More than 100 OTP SMS sent in an hour
An OTP SMS was sent outside India
More than 10 OTP SMS blocked by the region policy in an hour

documentation.subject: Roadside: possible OTP SMS abuse
documentation.content:
OTP SMS volume is unusual: more than 100 in an hour, a code sent outside India (the region policy should allow India only), or many blocked by the region policy (someone is trying).

Follow docs/runbooks/sms-abuse.md. Compare with sign-ins in A1: a normal SMS success rate is 70-85%, below 50% means abuse. Tune the 100/hour threshold after launch week (#62).
